Notes: Initialn-in Manda is irregular and rather strange. The samen-is found in Dongriya Kuwi,  but still, the evidence is too few to reconstruct something other than an initial vowel.

The problem with this root is that in most (or all dialects) of Kui-Kuwi it was not used alone,  but only in combination with the root*vā-'to come' (*ey-v[ā]-) or other suffixes. In Kui*ey-v-a>*ey-pa>*e-pa, whileeppais a secondary causative. In Kuwi_F this cluster is probably responsible for the inlaut-j-(since PK*-y-normally > Kuwi_F-y-), although the exact way of development is unclear. Kuwi_Mah is an archaic form:egowā-obviously results from*ey-vā-. Then-in Kuwi_D is mysterious (although it does have parallels in Manda).
